privacy-policy:
Bikelencia does not explicitly collect any data from your device.

For fetching the bike parkings data, the app accesses the api.bikelencia.precioso.design domain. This website is hosted on GitHub Pages and is subject to [GitHub's Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

Apple provides us by default with anonymous analytics about the app usage through its App Store. This data is subject to [Apple's Privacy Policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww/).

If you have any questions, please contact us at [bikelencia@precioso.design](mailto:bikelencia@precioso.design).
support: If you have any problems, feature requests, or questions, please contact us at [bikelencia@precioso.design](mailto:bikelencia@precioso.design).
